BiblicalUsage: Jehudith is Judith, a Canaanitess, the wife of Esau. In Genesis 26:34, Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Judith matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
